Chapter-Desc: The 64 Hexagrams of the I Ching

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷀ 
「1 乾」 Chien
the vital spirit of heaven
Verses.Word-for-Word: Good fortune is coming your way in anything you do. Force, the creative, strong action, the key, and god
Verses.Translation-En: “Flying dragon in the heavens.” This shows the great man at work.
Verses.Purport-En: Your courage and perseverance will reward you with great success If you know how to take your actions and ideals forward with a sense of justice, the forces of Heaven will support you and you will receive the success you desire. Always keep your spirit in harmony with nature. — Wilhelm: The Creative is the primal power, the source of all beginnings. Each of the four virtues—sublime, successful, advantageous, persevering—guides the superior man: he acts with timing, creativity, and moral strength, never forcing but always aligning with cosmic order.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷁ 
「2 坤」 K’un
a multiplicity of things
Verses.Word-for-Word: Field, the receptive, acquiescence, and the flow
Verses.Translation-En: Troubles and problems are solved with little difficulty.
Verses.Purport-En: To not lose the way, you must be patient not to force events. You will obtain great benefits and advantages if you learn how to adapt to various situations, using everyone and without taking initiative. This behaviour will lead you to fulfilling your aims. — Wilhelm: The Receptive does not contend but completes. Like the earth that receives heaven’s seed, you achieve by yielding, by opening to what comes. Do not act first; let things ripen, then serve with devoted strength.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷂ 
「3 屯」 Chun
difficulty getting started
Verses.Word-for-Word: Sprouting, difficulty at the beginning, gathering support, and hoarding
Verses.Translation-En: There is a great danger in gossip getting out of hand.
Verses.Purport-En: If you wish to undertake something new, you must consider difficulties which will certainly arise, especially at the beginning. Patience and faith in your goals will help you but will not be enough: you must choose someone who can help you and accept the advice of others with benevolence. — Wilhelm: Difficulty at the beginning is like a seed breaking through frozen ground. All pushing fails; instead, stabilise and gather helpers. The image of thunder and rain: chaos precedes order. Act only after hesitation is exhausted.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Enveloping, youthful folly, the young shoot, and discovering
Verses.Translation-En: Youthful foolishness. Wasting money. Your life is filled with idle gossip.
Verses.Purport-En: You want to reach a goal but in order to do so you will have to trust a Master or guide who will help you overcome obstacles. Initially, you will have the innocence of a child but then, thanks to experience, you will finally reach self-awareness. — Wilhelm: Youthful folly is not stupidity but inexperience. The teacher does not seek the pupil; the pupil seeks the teacher. One question at a time, no nagging. The mountain over the spring: stop confusion by disciplined simplicity.

Verses.Translation-En: Happiness is coming. Committed projects are successful.
Verses.Purport-En: You must learn how to wait without accelerating time. It is not the right moment to act. You must wait patiently for events to occur until the exact moment for acting arives. Your wait will be useful to relax and collect your strength. — Wilhelm: Waiting is not passive. Clouds rising to heaven: refreshment comes when the time is full. Eat and drink with equanimity. The Creative is above, the Abysmal below—water in danger, yet it always finds its level. Trust the natural unfolding.

Verses.Translation-En: There are obstacles that block everything you do.
Verses.Purport-En: Even if you know you are right, stubbornness will cause you harm and conflict. You will have to look for equilibrium and the possibly for meditation to avoid disagreements from occurring. It will be vital for you to recognise the moment to stop, even if it is half way through the journey/project. — Wilhelm: Conflict arises when the strong and weak cross. Heaven goes up, water goes down—no meeting. Do not prolong disputes. Even winning is loss. Turn back before the middle; change your mind. The superior man avoids litigation.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷆ 
「7 師」 Shih
the mass of humanity
Verses.Word-for-Word: Leading, the army and the troops
Verses.Translation-En: Plans find a favourable response.
Verses.Purport-En: Search for self-discipline to realise your aims. You must organise and manage all your inner strength to be able to confidently move toward your goals. To keep to schedule, you will have to persist and always be constant. — Wilhelm: The army needs a good commander, not the ruler’s meddling. Water under earth: hidden reserves. Discipline is not cruelty but order. Choose a leader for integrity, not for favour. One successful campaign then rest. Force only as last resort.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷇ 
「8 比」 Pi
a banding together
Verses.Translation-En: It is important that you unite with others and feel part of a group; this will bring you luck.
Verses.Purport-En: Approaching friends and people whom you trust helps in moments of need and always gives you great strength. So do not hesitate to put yourself forward in a disinterested way toward others. — Wilhelm: Water over earth: union without gaps. Holding together requires a central figure who is sincere, not coercive. The chosen one comes fourth. Do not follow the selfish; the way is mutual trust. Even outsiders enter if sincere. Fear not: fellowship is protection.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷈ 
「9 小畜」 Hsiao Ch’u
small involvement
Verses.Word-for-Word: Small Accumulating, the taming power of the small and small harvest
Verses.Translation-En: Not a good time to expand. Good time to relax.
Verses.Purport-En: At the moment you must wait and occupy yourself only with small things. You will be able to be victorious but you must not display this too much: use this period to analyse everything and be prepared to the best of your ability. — Wilhelm: The small tames the great. Wind above heaven: the gentle moves the hard. No great deeds now, only small accumulations. Do not push forward alone; call allies. Like rain that comes only after clouds gather—let your influence seep, not storm.

Verses.Translation-En: You must find the best way to behave toward others.
Verses.Purport-En: If you learn how to behave correctly, you will manage to conquer those people you want to, whatever their position. Through kindness, you will also gain a great deal from difficult and unpleasant people. — Wilhelm: Treading on the tiger’s tail, but it does not bite. Heaven above, lake below: outer form and inner joy. Conduct is ritual. The weak one steps carefully, yet succeeds. Do not test the dangerous; smoothness wins. Even the fierce are disarmed by propriety and sincerity.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷊ 
「11 泰」 Tai
rising above adversity
Verses.Translation-En: Relationships enjoy a period of great harmony.
Verses.Purport-En: This is a good moment for harmony in which peace, concordance and success govern. If you wish to prosper and be lucky, you will have to maintain this state. Ask help from someone who is capable of stabilising this favourable situation. — Wilhelm: Heaven and earth unite. The small departs, the great arrives. Everything flows. It is the time of universal harmony. The ruler completes virtue. Do not waste this phase: create laws, help what is low. But nothing is more fragile than perfect peace—prepare for the inevitable turn.

Verses.Translation-En: It is not worth acting in this particular moment as the general situation is not entirely favourable.
Verses.Purport-En: You will gain more profits by pulling back temporarily and maintaining your independence. Your wisdom now consists in waiting and avoiding the company of unpleasant people. — Wilhelm: Heaven and earth do not unite. The great goes up, the small stays down. Standstill. The superior man retracts his light. Do not seek office or honour. What is not yet ripe cannot be forced. Withdraw into your inner worth. The low climb, but the wheel will turn—wait for the return.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷌ 
「13 同人」 T’ung Jen
people who have affinity with each other
Verses.Word-for-Word: Concording People, fellowship with men and gathering men
Verses.Translation-En: To achieve your aims, you will have to unite with virtuous people.
Verses.Purport-En: Indeed it will be easier to reach every objective if a group of individuals (albeit of different characters), have the same common goal. However, always keep your own personality and act so that you benefit one another. — Wilhelm: Fire above heaven: light overcomes separation. Fellowship in the open, not in the dark. It requires clarity and justice. The ruler identifies clan and stranger alike. Even across distance, the good unite. Do not close ranks in fear—open the gate. The great person leads by example.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷍ 
「14 大有」 Ta Yu
having great possessions
Verses.Word-for-Word: Great Possessing, possession in great measure and the great possession
Verses.Translation-En: What you have lost will return to you.
Verses.Purport-En: To win, you must use neither aggression nor arrogance. Indeed, you can obtain great things by being calm. Your attitude of apparent weakness is your strength and nobody can oppose you. Great success is certain to arrive. — Wilhelm: Fire in heaven: light illuminates all. Great possession is not hoarding but sharing. The ruler honours the virtuous and stops the wicked. Heaven blesses modesty. Even the small contribute. Do not display wealth; use it to order the world. Then no enemy remains.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷎ 
「15 謙」 Ch’ien
holding one’s tongue
Verses.Translation-En: Do not forget that in life, nothing remains unchanged and everything evolves through transformation.
Verses.Purport-En: You must learn how to evaluate every situation with the correct amount of modesty. If you are living a moment of success, re-dimension your enthusiasm; If, on the other hand, you are waiting for some development, be patient; everything turns and re-news itself. — Wilhelm: Earth over mountain: the high hides within the low. Modesty is the way of heaven: it lights but does not burn. The superior man reduces excess. Even the proud bow before a humble heart. No beginning, no end—humility never perishes. It is the vessel of fortune.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷏ 
「16 豫」 Yu
eagerness to start
Verses.Translation-En: If you must lead a group, you must also understand others’ intentions and moods.
Verses.Purport-En: You will be able to fulfil your aims by eliminating every kind of resistance provided that you can understand and go along with everyone. Your enthusiasm will do the rest. — Wilhelm: Thunder comes from earth: joy erupts. Enthusiasm means preparation. The ruler makes music and rituals to harmonise. But excess of joy brings downfall. Do not follow the flatterers. Establish order before the celebration. One resolute act overcomes delay. Enthusiasm must have a firm backbone.

Verses.Translation-En: This is a time that favours you.
Verses.Purport-En: In this particular moment, try not to waste energy in fighting but wait without forcing Destiny’s hand. If you learn how to adapt yourself to the situation at hand, by coming to an agreement you will obtain great well-being and assured success. — Wilhelm: Thunder over the lake: the moving follows the still. Following is not weakness but flexibility. The superior man rests at night to restore. At the right moment, you must attach to what is great. Let the strong lead, you follow without shame. At the end, release.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Correcting, work on what has been spoiled, decaying and branch
Verses.Translation-En: This is the right moment to modify some of your habits.
Verses.Purport-En: Stagnant situations can only get worse. Eliminate laziness, intervene decisively and resolve any problem within the next few days. — Wilhelm: Wind under mountain: decay hidden from sight. Work on spoiled things requires three people: father, son, and the renewer. Do not continue old errors. Establish order by clarifying duty. A small improvement each day. The end of disorder is order. Do not fear hard beginnings—corruption reversed becomes creation.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷒ 
「19 臨」 Lin
different classes of people
Verses.Translation-En: If you want others to approach you, first you must approach them.
Verses.Purport-En: A positive moment, do not fear anything. Make the most of this as collaboration is very good at this particular time. — Wilhelm: Earth above lake: the high nears the low. Approach is not aggression but compassion. The ruler educates and protects. As the moon nears earth, tides rise. Use this nearness to teach, not to exploit. A great turning point: what is below rises. Sincere approach lasts. The eight trigrams show its stages—do not stop midway.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷓ 
「20 觀」 Kuan
looking, seeing, confronting
Verses.Translation-En: To take the best decisions, in this phase you must concede all the time necessary to reflect calmly.
Verses.Purport-En: Evaluate every single aspect of the situation. Observe and understand everything before action. — Wilhelm: Wind over earth: the ruler views the people’s way. Contemplation is ritual washing before sacrifice. Do not yet act; watch. The superior man observes to transform. Four types: child’s glance (shallow), woman’s view (domestic), self-view (progress), and state-view (noble). To be seen is to be examined. Purify yourself first.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Gnawing Bite, biting through and biting and chewing
Verses.Translation-En: The agony of loneliness finds respite.
Verses.Purport-En: In this phase, the right way to face the situation is to intervene with decisiveness. It isn’t the right time to ignore a problem, or stick your head in the sand. You must re-establish justice, use every means at your disposal: perseverance will help. — Wilhelm: Thunder and lightning: bite through obstacles. The mouth holds the hard object. Use prison and punishment to clarify. Justice must be lightning-fast but not cruel. The superior man removes what blocks the way. After the bite, the mouth closes. Order returns.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷕ 
「22 賁」 Pi
grace and beauty
Verses.Translation-En: Consider beauty and look for it both within yourself and in others.
Verses.Purport-En: Even though beauty is simply an ornament, its contemplation can bring joy, albeit ephemeral. Highlight your own beauty and admire that of others. That which you focus on, expands. — Wilhelm: Fire under mountain: adornment without falseness. Grace is not deception. The superior man governs with light ceremony, not heavy law. But too much decoration hides reality. White is the final colour—simplicity over embroidery. Ornament must serve truth, not replace it.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷖ 
「23 剝」 Po
finality of death
Verses.Translation-En: This is the moment of expectation for you as sometimes danger can be hidden yet it’s present, even if you don’t see it.
Verses.Purport-En: Some problems occur inside, in silence. Do not put yourself forward and take no decisions. Postpone everything and retreate into your safe zone. — Wilhelm: Mountain on earth: crumbling from below. The bed is stripped of its frame. Do not go forward. The inferior rise, the worthy sink. But the single yang remains above. When a fruit falls, a seed remains. The superior man withdraws to nourish the root. Night before the return. Endure the stripping.

Verses.Translation-En: Even a friend can become an enemy. You need patience for this time of confusion.
Verses.Purport-En: After a period of darkness, the light always returns; now you can face a new phase of renewal. This is the right moment as you will be able to regenerate yourself. There will be no resistance on your path toward success. — Wilhelm: Thunder under earth: the winter solstice. Return is the small yang born from yin’s death. It is the gate of heaven. Do not travel far—turn back on the seventh day. The superior man rests business to cultivate nature. Mistakes are mended quickly. One line returns, the world revives.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Without Embroiling, innocence (the unexpected) and pestilence
Verses.Translation-En: Your lover is betraying you, be careful.
Verses.Purport-En: Listen to what your internal voice suggests and go forward doing things you know are right. Do not act for a particular aim, or hoping for a financial reward. Be simple and listen to your profound inner-Being. Act freely and with serenity. — Wilhelm: Heaven under thunder: movement without falsehood. Innocence is natural, not calculated. Do not scheme. Unexpected fortune or calamity comes. If you fall ill without acting, you recover. Do not take dangerous trips. The superior man rests in fate. What is not earned cannot be kept.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷙ 
「26 大畜」 Ta Ch’u
big involvement
Verses.Word-for-Word: Great Accumulating, the taming power of the great, great storage, and potential energy
Verses.Translation-En: Clarity emerges where there was confusion.
Verses.Purport-En: Great force of spirit and great physical power are hidden inside you. Even if you don’t always notice it, this potential is present and you must simply learn to cultivate and discipline it. This is the right moment for using what’s inside you. — Wilhelm: Heaven within mountain: the great tames the strong. Accumulate virtue and knowledge. Do not go forward yet—nourish. A young ox’s horns are tied. The superior man recalls many past deeds to refine the present. After the storehouse is full, you move. Then no obstacle stops you.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Swallowing, the corners of the mouth (providing nourishment), jaws and comfort/security
Verses.Translation-En: There’s an excellent person helping you, a mentor.
Verses.Purport-En: Nourishment of your body and soul are equally important and correlated to one another. Be careful therefore to look after what you eat and pay great attention to your diet. You are what you eat. You’ll understand what are your limits and will find equilibrium. — Wilhelm: Thunder under mountain: the jaws open and close. Nourishment requires correct speech and food. Do not seek from the low; ask the high. The tiger watches, appetite waits. The superior man is careful with words and portions. Nourish others first, then you are fed. Stillness above, movement below—chewing slowly.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷛ 
「28 大過」 Ta Kuo
great excess
Verses.Word-for-Word: Great Exceeding, preponderance of the great, great surpassing and critical mass
Verses.Translation-En: At the moment, events are overpowering and superior to your strength; you cannot win and it is useless to oppose them.
Verses.Purport-En: You must try to eliminate this obstacle, avoid danger by pulling yourself away from the situation. Be firm and decisive. Learn to say no. — Wilhelm: Lake over wood: the beam bends. Great excess: the weight is too much. Ordinary rules fail. In times of crisis, solitary heroism works. Even the withered poplar flowers. The superior man stands alone without fear. Crossing the water at night: danger but possible. Do not hold to convention—act extraordinarily.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Gorge, the abyss (in the oceanographic sense) and repeated entrapment
Verses.Translation-En: The image of the Abysmal is like seeing a mirage.
Verses.Purport-En: You feel you are in the midst of danger and negative circumstances. You must be true to your principles and profound ideals. If you resist with courage and perseverance, being always faithful to your sense of justice, you’ll soon be free from this period of adversity. — Wilhelm: Water over water: the abyss repeated. Danger grows deeper. But water flows through any crack. The superior man practices virtue like flowing water. In the heart of danger, sincerity works. One false step, then fall. Yet by repetition of testing, you become like water—smooth, deep, unstoppable.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Radiance, the clinging, fire and the net
Verses.Translation-En: Even if you have reached success, you must never forget who is present and near you.
Verses.Purport-En: Those who act in your shadow contribute to sustain your position. There is always reciprocity and relations between people, whatever your level of evolution may be. Do not walk alone. — Wilhelm: Fire over fire: radiance doubled. Clinging needs the right fuel. Light is beauty but also dependence. The superior man keeps the heart bright. Do not moan; shine. Like the cow that stays with its calf. Use clarity to order the realm. But setting suns warn: all glory fades. Use the light while you have it.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷞ 
「31 咸」 Hsien
something felt in the heart
Verses.Translation-En: This is a favourable moment for you if you wish to start up or improve an emotional relationship.
Verses.Purport-En: Indeed, now there is great harmony in the cosmos. The situation is favourable for change; this could make your heart and the one of whoever is near you richer. — Wilhelm: Lake over mountain: empty space receives. Influence is not forcing—it is the young woman’s quiet power. Do not chase; be still. The feet, calves, thighs, and heart each respond. The superior man opens to receive. Not taking but allowing. The meeting of two empty vessels fills only when both are ready. Patience moves the strongest.

Verses.Translation-En: Do not interrupt or modify the way you are going.
Verses.Purport-En: Everything evolves and events run continuously toward their destination. This movement is positive, live it with self-awareness and you’ll face all great and small difficulties with ease. — Wilhelm: Thunder over wind: duration through movement. Constancy is not stillness—it is like a couple who keep their roles. The superior man stands firm without changing side. The horse that runs straight does not stumble. If you begin well and end poorly, shame comes. Perseverance for its own sake is not virtue. But constant virtue creates the world.

Verses.Translation-En: It’s the right moment to step back and observe the situation from outside, in a quiet corner.
Verses.Purport-En: Renouncing action doesn’t mean defeat; instead, it’s a sign of great wisdom. Collect your strengths, you will evaluate the current events and intervene at the right moment with great success. — Wilhelm: Heaven under mountain: the strong retreat. Retreat is not cowardice; the pig’s tail warns of grasping. The small rise, the great withdraw. The superior man keeps distance from the low. Do not desire false honour. At the right moment, retreat is advance. Even a retreating army can win. Wait in the wilds—then return.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷡ 
「34 大壯」 Ta Chuang
great wisdom
Verses.Word-for-Word: Great Invigorating, the power of the great and great maturity
Verses.Translation-En: Meetings with friends go smoothly.
Verses.Purport-En: Now you have the opportunity to obtain your desires and reach your aims. Nothing is impossible as inside you there’s great strength and you are fully aware of this. But beware: avoid over-confidence or arrogance and be sure you are always in the right. — Wilhelm: Thunder over heaven: the great and strong. Do not use strength on the small. The ram butts a fence, its horns trap. The superior man acts with propriety. What is great cannot advance by force. It is like a cart dragged by an ox: slow but certain. Do not boast. Perseverance in rightness wins.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷢ 
「35 晉」 Chin
meting the great Man
Verses.Translation-En: For you, this is a winning moment which you must know how to make the most of.
Verses.Purport-En: Nothing lasts forever. Remember you will obtain the best results by joining with people who share your interests and aspirations. You will all help one another. — Wilhelm: Fire above earth: the sun rising. Progress means the prince receives many horses in a day. Do not worry about losing; be sincere. Like the kudzu vine that climbs but does not harm. The superior man lights himself to shine. Even those who regret transform. Receiving blessings, you must give. The radiance grows by being shared.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷣ 
「36 明夷」 Ming I
a darkening
Verses.Word-for-Word: Darkening of the Light, brilliance injured and intelligence hidden
Verses.Translation-En: It is not an easy moment and even if you feel to be in the darkness, light is there, albeit hidden.
Verses.Purport-En: For now, do not confide your thoughts in those around you. Keep your integrity in silence. — Wilhelm: Earth over fire: the sun is wounded. Darkening means the wise hide their light. The exiled prince endures. Do not eat the left-over feast—it poisons. The superior man keeps low. Like the bird that folds wings at dusk. Even in total darkness, the light is within. To survive, become obscure. Use patience as a weapon. The darkest hour is before dawn.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷤ 
「37 家人」 Chia Jen
the family type
Verses.Word-for-Word: Dwelling People, the family (the clan) and family members
Verses.Translation-En: Try to understand what your role and position are within the family or social group.
Verses.Purport-En: In fact, you will get the best results by being faithful to your current role, contributing to the well-being of others. — Wilhelm: Wind over fire: the family’s order. The woman’s place is inside, the man’s outside. The superior man speaks truth and acts. The family needs the stern father and the devoted mother. Even the pig and fish are fed. Do not lose the centre. If the family is ordered, the state is ordered. One word from a ruler, trust from all. Begin with yourself.

Verses.Translation-En: It is not worth trying to harmonise things, people or situations which are simply not compatible.
Verses.Purport-En: Remember, everyone has different personalities and it’s important for you to maintain yours. You can find a harmonious way, even if this is in the distant future. — Wilhelm: Fire over lake: sisters who marry and separate. Opposition is not a dead end—it is difference. Two women live together but wills diverge. The superior man endures small differences. A horse may be lost, then found. A bow turned into a belt. Small things can unite what is split. Do not force unity; see the common core.

Verses.Translation-En: This is not the right moment to act; there are difficulties and it’s worth it for you to stop and reflect.
Verses.Purport-En: When something doesn’t work, do not blame someone else, instead, look for possible causes within you. Remember that you can always lean on someone you have trusted for some time now. — Wilhelm: Water over mountain: the path is blocked. Limping means turning back is easier. The southwest is open, the northeast blocked. The superior man seeks himself. When meeting great danger, call helpers. Even a great king needs a friend. Do not push forward alone. Three travellers share the load. Arrival ends the hardship.

Verses.Translation-En: Your social life takes-off, suddenly you are very popular.
Verses.Purport-En: This is the moment when adversities will be overcome. You’ll realise that all problems are now behind you and that soon the road back to normality will be free. When you finally have victory, try not to show any form of rancour. — Wilhelm: Thunder over water: the storm breaks. Liberation happens when the high gives up. The southwest is lucky. One arrow kills the fox in the field. The superior man forgives errors and pardons. Do not hunt what is already released. To move is to untie. After the knot is gone, rest.

Verses.Translation-En: In this period, you must try to eliminate all which is superficial in favour of what is essential.
Verses.Purport-En: You must not consider this as a loss, because what you lose on one hand, you gain on another. To be lucky, you must concentrate only on what is really useful. — Wilhelm: Mountain over lake: decrease the lower for the higher. Loss is not waste—it is sacrifice. Two cups are enough, not eight. The superior man reduces anger and desire. When sincerity increases, form decreases. Gain and loss travel together. Do not hoard alone. If you lose now, you gain later. The heart satisfied needs little.

Verses.Translation-En: Misfortune transforms into good fortune.
Verses.Purport-En: Make the most of this moment to grow and evolve. Now you can work on spiritual elevation and reach important goals. Remember you will grow more quickly if you help people who need you. — Wilhelm: Wind over thunder: increase from below. What is reduced above enriches below. The superior man moves good and forgives evil. Do not build a tower alone. Ten pairs of turtles obey the ruler. The middle path increases everything. Give without expectation. The heart that expands receives all.

Verses.Translation-En: Determination gets you everywhere, it reaps you benefits.
Verses.Purport-En: Now you can finally take that decision which puts an end to a current hostile and unfavourable situation. Remember that it’ll be enough for you to make the first step, the rest will come along. — Wilhelm: Lake over heaven: the flood breaks through. Determination is like removing a weak official. One cry and then quiet. Do not make decisions at night—wait for daylight. Even the strong horse is tired. The superior man gives, not hoards. When the break comes, it is clean. No second guessing.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Coupling, coming to meet and meeting
Verses.Translation-En: An unexpected encounter is likely to take place. Don’t go on the first impression.
Verses.Purport-En: Try to understand what’s hidden beneath the external veil. Try to avoid dangers and you’ll obtain advantages and long-term success. — Wilhelm: Heaven over wind: the unexpected meeting. A strong wind sweeps the ground. Do not marry this woman—she is like a galloping horse. The superior man does not keep what falls into his hands without cause. If you do not act, the encounter ends. But if you grasp, you must hold. A sudden gift is often a hidden hook.

Verses.Translation-En: Now is a good time to meet others and make projects together.
Verses.Purport-En: Remember that in a group you must always consider different ideas and expectations. Avoid all pretensions. — Wilhelm: Lake over earth: the gathering of water. The ruler builds temples for the spirits. A sincere sacrifice brings help. Do not gather just anyone; the wrong person weakens. The superior man sharpens his weapons for unexpected need. Even crying leads to laughter. One false inclusion spoils the whole. When the pure gather, heaven moves.

Verses.Translation-En: Fear nothing, for this is a favourable moment.
Verses.Purport-En: You can reach high slowly and with constancy. Along the way you’ll meet important and influential people. If they deserve your trust, treasure their example and advice. — Wilhelm: Earth over wood: the tree grows. Ascending is not leaping—it is gradual. The south gate opens. The superior man follows virtue step by step. Do not doubt; use sincerity. One step, then another. Like the mountain built from dust. Your offering is accepted. The top is not the end; it is a new beginning.

Verses.Translation-En: Don’t give up, even if something is worrying you.
Verses.Purport-En: Make the most of this circumstance and transform every difficulty into a stimulus so that you can go ahead. Have faith in destiny which always changes bad into good. Luck is for the bravest! — Wilhelm: Lake over water: no outflow. Oppression means the noble are trapped. The throat is bound, the buttocks wounded. The superior man dies for his mission. Even in a copper cart, the spirit rides free. A full cup spills—do not drink. Words are not heard. Yet the golden chariot arrives. Sincerity breaks the cage.

Verses.Translation-En: External circumstances regularly change quickly.
Verses.Purport-En: You must consider however that the most intimate essence of man is unchanged over time. Give what you have to grow. Try to help others as well as you can. — Wilhelm: Wood over water: the well never empties. A village may move, but the well stays. The superior man gives tirelessly. The bottom is mud—no one drinks. Clean the well, then the king drinks first. A broken bucket is a shame. Do not cover the well. The heart that gives never dries. Draw again and again.

Verses.Translation-En: There will be a radical change which will let you make the most of renewing the current state of affairs.
Verses.Purport-En: Be careful to consider others’ needs, not just your own. In this way you’ll reach your objective with serenity. — Wilhelm: Lake over fire: the watery puts out the hot. Revolution is not violence—it is like the tiger changing its stripes. The wise person first shows his own pattern. On your own day, you are believed. Change after you have tested. The leopard changes spots, but the small still follow. Do not be the last to adapt. Once complete, the new is trusted.

Verses.Translation-En: A lucky moment with positive and favourable external forces.
Verses.Purport-En: Remember however that he or she who is in a privileged position must be attentive to those who are not as fortunate. — Wilhelm: Fire over wood: the cooking vessel. The ruler makes the cauldron to feed the wise. The feet are weak, the ears strong. Yellow gold and jade rings. The superior man nourishes the worthy. Do not try to tip the cauldron—it spills. The servant fills, the master eats. At the top, one is honoured. The new vessel holds all. Heaven blesses the table.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Shake, the arousing (shock, thunder) and thunder
Verses.Translation-En: Influential friends help and protect you.
Verses.Purport-En: An event will occur which will change the actual state of the things and the current situation. Make the most of this change by being calm. This will help you strengthen your character and make you wise and virtuous. — Wilhelm: Thunder over thunder: shock repeated. The ruler fears and cultivates. Laughing words after the shock. The sacrifice lasts a hundred days. Do not drop the ladle. Thunder frightens for miles, but the calm one smiles. The superior man checks himself. When the lightning comes, do not run—count. Three shocks, then peace.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Bound, keeping still, mountain and stilling
Verses.Translation-En: Don’t run away from situations and don’t avoid what could be a problem.
Verses.Purport-En: Now it is opportune for you to stop and observe things as they really are. This moment of calm and reflection will give you the necessary awareness to go forward in the future. — Wilhelm: Mountain over mountain: double stillness. The back is what you cannot see. Stop when you should stop. The superior man does not let his thoughts leave his place. The heart moves, the body stays. The mouth does not speak. Not a single movement—yet nothing is missed. The ultimate rest is not death. It is the centre of the wheel.

Verses.Translation-En: To obtain what you want, you must proceed gradually.
Verses.Purport-En: Do not try to rush things or be taken by enthusiasm. To reach the desired results, go forward calm and with constancy; on the way you will med your errors. — Wilhelm: Wood over mountain: the tree grows slowly. Gradual progress is like the wild geese: first on shore, then on stones, then dry land. The superior man stays in his place. Not all at once. The tree takes years. Do not push the river. The woman marries but waits. The male proceeds by steps. No haste, no rest.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷵ 
「54 歸妹」 Kuei Mei
marrying girl
Verses.Word-for-Word: Converting the Maiden, the marrying maiden and returning maiden
Verses.Translation-En: In your social relations, both friendships and love affairs, you must always respect fundamental rules.
Verses.Purport-En: The ones which establish the different roles people have. Try therefore to proceed with the right amount of discretion, avoiding difficulties and paving he way for success. — Wilhelm: Thunder over lake: the younger sister marries. Not the first wife. The girl who is not the primary. The superior man sees the end from the beginning. Do not marry for advantage. The woman carries a basket but weaves nothing. The man sacrifices a sheep but draws no blood. A hollow marriage: better to wait. Do not force roles that do not fit.

Verses.Translation-En: For you, this is the moment for great fortune and prosperity.
Verses.Purport-En: You can reach your objectives and success. Make the most of this lucky situation. Remember that great opportunities only come round once and you must not let them slip away. — Wilhelm: Thunder and lightning: abundance. The ruler makes laws and judges. Noon is the time of fullness—then the sun sets. The house is large, but the blind one sits inside. Alone for three years. The superior man fears the end. Do not trust the full measure. The great din covers truth. At the peak, look down. What is too full leaks.

Verses.Translation-En: Now is not the moment for starting projects; consider how everything is changeable and prone to transformation.
Verses.Purport-En: For the moment you must rely on what you have and make it suffice. Free yourself from the sense of possessions and expectations which poison life. — Wilhelm: Fire over mountain: the traveller stays briefly. The wanderer needs modesty. The bird burns its nest. The traveller sings, then weeps. The superior man is careful with law and punishment. A small inn is safe; a large inn brings robbers. Do not show your wealth. Even a cow lost on the road finds its way. Travel light, return heavy only with experience.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Ground, the gentle (the penetrating, wind) and calculations
Verses.Translation-En: In this period, your doubts dissipate and problems are resolved.
Verses.Purport-En: The best way to see clearly is to observe the situation. Everything will sort itself out. — Wilhelm: Wind over wind: repetition without end. The gentle penetrates like a ruler’s decree. The superior man continues his work. Low before high: the servant speaks, the master acts. Three times the ruler’s command. Even the lost money is found. But the gentle can also be the mosquito’s buzz. Do not be only soft. The warrior inside the tent must act. Penetration without force wins.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Open, the joyous, lake and usurpation
Verses.Translation-En: In this period, you can overcome all your difficulties with cheerfulness and lightheartedness.
Verses.Purport-En: You’ll enjoy being with others. Share this positive energy with everyone; there is great harmony inside you and you must learn to appreciate and enjoy it. — Wilhelm: Lake over lake: joy doubled. The superior man encourages friends. Joy is not reckless—it is like the evening rest. The inner joy is true, the outer may be false. Do not trust the flatterer. The broken line shows the weak. After harmony comes release. To go away in joy is right. The lake empties slowly, but its bottom is always wet.

Verses.Translation-En: You will get the impression that something is preventing you from reaching your aims.
Verses.Purport-En: This could be because of your indifference or coldness towards others. So it’s important you relax and get rid of all your tension: then you will be able to open up to others. — Wilhelm: Wind over water: dispersion of ice. The ruler sacrifices to the spirits. Dispersion is not loss—it is regrouping. Like the wind breaks the frozen lake. The hut is swept clean. A horse runs free. The superior man leaves his old self. Blood dissolves into energy. At the top, the cry is heard. Separation before reunion.

Verses.Translation-En: In this period, self control and self-discipline are fundamental.
Verses.Purport-En: Only in this way will you be able to achieve your all and avoid any harm. Do not follow your instincts but try to limit yourself to always keeping in mind boundaries you must not cross. — Wilhelm: Lake over water: the overflowing lake makes boundaries. Limitation is like numbers and measure. Do not travel when bitter. The superior man creates degrees. If the limitation is too tight, no one walks. If too loose, the dam breaks. The middle path: not too many or few. Sweet words harm. Silence at the right time is the highest limit.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷼ 
「61 中孚」 Chung Fu
inner truth
Verses.Word-for-Word: Center Returning, inner truth and central return
Verses.Translation-En: If you want a good and satisfying relationship with people around you, sincerity and honesty are important.
Verses.Purport-En: Do not be silent, even with those who are different from you. Be available and let others approach you with joy and spontaneity. — Wilhelm: Wind over lake: truth moves the heart. Inner truth reaches the pig and fish. The superior man discusses doubtful cases. The young crane sings from the shade. Its young answer. The drum is half used. The moon is almost full. Do not try to appear good; be good. The heart that is true has no lock. Even the tiger watches, then passes.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷽ 
「62 小過」 Hsiao Kuo
small error/weakness
Verses.Word-for-Word: Small Exceeding, preponderance of the small and small surpassing
Verses.Translation-En: It is not the right moment to accomplish great undertakings.
Verses.Purport-En: In fact, now you can obtain something by moving slowly and being constant. Be content with your position and in this way you’ll go far. — Wilhelm: Thunder over mountain: small excess. The small exceed the great. The bird flies too high—nets below. The superior man is careful in grief and generous in joy. Do not act with the great now; act with the small. One step too far and you fall. The cloud but no rain. At the top, the flood. Beware of the slightest excess. It drowns.

Verses.Word-for-Word: Already Fording, after completion and already completed or already done
Verses.Translation-En: Finally, you have achieved what you desired.
Verses.Purport-En: Your objective and success have been reached, At this point you must simply refine some particulars. You must maintain what you have built: everything changes and so it’ll be necessary to be careful that you don’t lose everything. — Wilhelm: Water over fire: after the crossing. Completion is order: the fox wets its tail. The ruler thinks of danger. At the beginning, ease; at the end, disorder. The woman loses her veil—seek it. The sacrificer has a small offering. The neighbour’s wall is broken. In the middle, the blood stops. But after success, the smallest slackness ruins all. Do not rest.

Verses.Verse-Text:
䷿ 
「64 未濟」 Wei Chi
before completion
Verses.Word-for-Word: Not Yet Fording, before completion and not yet completed
Verses.Translation-En: Sadness. A period of misfortune that lasts 28 days.
Verses.Purport-En: This period is full of useful opportunities for you to achieve what you want. This is a transitional phase which can move you from a negative problematic phase to a positive serene phase. Continue to be prudent: success is in your hands and nearby. — Wilhelm: Fire over water: not yet forded. The young fox almost crosses then wets its tail. No goal is reached. The river is wide. The superior man discerns things. One drum, then stop. A bag full but untied. The wine and meat arrive—do not drink. The right time is coming but not yet. One more step. Do not force the crossing. Wait for the water to calm.

Verses.Translation-En: tis’ not the best time to ask.
Verses.Purport-En: Answers are not being received. — Wilhelm: There is a time for asking and a time for silence. When no answer comes, the oracle reflects the asker’s own confusion. Rest your mind, clarify your heart, then approach again.

Verses.Translation-En: Wasn’t able to get an answer at this moment.
Verses.Purport-En: Breathe in and out, and then ask again. — Wilhelm: The Yarrow stalks require the right state of mind. If the reading fails, it is not the oracle’s fault. Calm your breathing, clear your intention, then cast again with reverence. The answer will come when the vessel is empty.
